question: Find the mean proportional between (4 + √5) and (12 - 2√20)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mean proportional of two numbers a and b is √(a × b).

⇒ a = 4 + √5, b = 12 − 2√20 = 12 − 4√5

⇒ a × b = (4 + √5) × 4(3 − √5)

⇒ a × b = 4(12 − 4√5 + 3√5 − 5) = 4(7 − √5)

⇒ Mean proportional = √[4(7 − √5)] = 2√(7 − √5)

**∴ The correct answer is 2√(7 − √5).**
